problem_statement: The Vuestic Admin dashboard is a Vue single-page admin console with a shared shell (collapsible sidebar + top bar) wrapping routed pages: Dashboard, Projects, Users, Payments, and more. The Projects page presents the team's work as a grid of project cards, each tagged with a status (In progress, Completed, Important, Archived, Planning). A 'Project focus' filter bar sits above that grid: a labelled row of status chips plus a live 'Showing N of 20' readout, and the same bar is meant to recur on the Dashboard and Users pages so the operator can jump to a focus from anywhere. In its current state the filter bar is styled as a single fixed-width, non-wrapping chip row, so on a 390px mobile viewport the chip row runs past the edge and the whole page scrolls horizontally; on desktop the project cards collapse out of their grid into an overlapping, near-white-on-near-white illegible pile; and the bar has been dropped from the Dashboard and Users routes. Restyle the Project focus bar and its project grid so the chip row wraps and stays within the mobile viewport, the cards return to a clean legible grid on desktop, and the shared bar is restored across the Dashboard, Projects, and Users routes, while keeping the chip filter's live count and card filtering working exactly as before and leaving every other page and widget untouched.
required_content: A 'Project focus' filter bar above the Projects grid with status chips (All projects, In progress, Completed, Important, Archived, Planning).
A live readout of the form 'Showing N of 20 focus label' that updates when a status chip is clicked.
A responsive chip row that wraps within a 390px mobile viewport without causing horizontal page overflow.
A clean, legible project card grid on desktop (no overlapping or contrast-failed cards).
The shared Project focus bar present on the Dashboard, Projects, and Users routes.
design_constraints: Keep the Vuestic look and feel: the chips, readout, and cards use the app's existing color tokens (--va-primary, --va-background-element, --va-text-primary) and card styling.
The chip row must wrap (flex-wrap) with zero-min-width children so it never forces horizontal document overflow on mobile.
The project card grid must remain a responsive CSS grid (1 / 2 / 3 columns) with legible text; no negative-margin overlap and no near-white-on-near-white text.
Do not add or remove routes, pages, dependencies, charts, tables, or unrelated widgets; the change is confined to the Project focus bar, its stylesheet, its grid, and the per-route mount whitelist.
state_constraints: desktop_initial: Dashboard route at 1440px; shared Project focus bar visible below the page title.
mobile_initial: Dashboard route at 390px; no horizontal page overflow.
desktop_projects: Projects route at 1440px; Project focus bar with 6 status chips and a 'Showing 20 of 20 All projects' readout above a clean 3-column card grid.
mobile_projects: Projects route at 390px; chip row wraps within the viewport, no horizontal overflow.
desktop_dashboard: Dashboard route at 1440px; the shared Project focus bar is present (cross-page continuity).
desktop_users: Users route at 1440px; the shared Project focus bar is present (cross-page continuity).
projects_filter_completed: Projects route after clicking the 'Completed' chip; readout reads 'Showing 5 of 20 Completed' and only completed cards remain.
projects_filter_important: Projects route after clicking the 'Important' chip; readout reads 'Showing 5 of 20 Important'.
mobile_dashboard: Dashboard route at 390px; no horizontal overflow.
desktop_projects_scrolled: Projects route at 1440px scrolled to the card grid; cards remain a legible grid.

change_completion: The Project focus bar renders above the Projects grid with the six status chips and a live 'Showing N of 20' readout.
Clicking a status chip filters the visible project cards and updates the readout count and focus label accordingly.
design_consistency: The chips, readout, and cards reuse Vuestic's existing color tokens and card styling so the bar looks native to the admin theme.
The shared Project focus bar appears on the Dashboard, Projects, and Users routes with consistent styling.
responsive: On a 390px mobile viewport the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow beyond a 24px tolerance.
The project card grid reflows from three columns to one on narrow viewports without clipping.
regression: The project cards render as a clean, legible grid on desktop with no overlapping cards or contrast-failed text.
Dashboard charts, the Users table, navigation, sidebar, and all other pages remain unchanged.
evaluation_rubric.scoring_notes: A correct patch is a small, source-level restyle of the Project focus bar's stylesheet plus restoring its per-route mount whitelist, keeping the existing chip-filter wiring intact. Recoloring alone, freezing the readout, or leaving the mobile overflow / desktop overlap unrepaired are all incorrect.

author_notes: Native lever for this Vuestic Admin dashboard: the Projects page's own project-card grid with a 'Project focus' status filter and live count. The graded image and screenshot evidence covers the filter bar chips, the readout, and the project card grid, an SVG-free DOM-rendered component. The reassigned repo is epicmaxco vuestic-admin, a Vue plus Vite admin template; design keywords: responsive chip row wrap, legible card grid, cross-page continuity, live filter count.
